name: Slithering Scar
summary: In southern Un'Goro, the Gorishi swarm presses into the crater. Their hive tunnels through the cliffs and threatens life in the basin.

sections.title: The Gorishi Hive
sections.body:
In southern Un'Goro, the Gorishi hive cuts into the cliffs. This organized strain of silithid has burrows and egg chambers through the rock. Workers and tunnelers tend eggs and grubs, while towering wasp broods fill the warrens below.

The colony also raises fledgling silithid colossi, behemoths meant to carve an uncontested path through the crater's ecology. Strange crystals pulse inside the hive with an unnatural resonance, focusing the colony's dark, coordinated will.

sections.title: A Missing Ward
sections.body:
Scholars and explorers crossing Un'Goro's perimeter find no ancient crystalline pylon on its southern boundary. Pylons stand sentinel along the basin's northern, eastern, and western edges. Through this unprotected gap, the Gorishi have burrowed inward from the neighboring deserts.

Did the silithid undermine a forgotten southern ward, or enter where the crater's primordial wards were weakest? Those watching the swarm's rapid expansion have no answer.

faq.answer: The Gorishi swarm inhabits a hive complex carved into Un'Goro Crater's southern cliff walls.

faq.q: What are the silithid doing here?
faq.answer: The Gorishi dig vast underground tunnels, tend nursery chambers filled with grubs and eggs, and raise massive silithid colossi to establish dominance over the crater.

faq.q: Why is there no pylon in the south like the other regions?
faq.answer: Ancient crystal pylons mark Un'Goro's northern, eastern, and western edges, but none stands on the southern cliffs. The Slithering Scar emerged where this protective boundary is missing.

faq.q: What dangerous creatures inhabit the hive?
faq.answer: Workers, reavers, and stingers inhabit the Scar, along with developing colossi and ferocious broodmothers such as Clutchmother Zavas.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see how the Gorishi hive's aggressive spread threatens the crater's untamed vitality. Stay vigilant against this unnatural infestation.
